# gpuma Documentation

> Documentation for the gpuma package.

GPU geometry optimization of molecules with machine-learned interatomic potentials (UMA, ORB-v3, SevenNet, AIMNet2), driven by the gpuma CLI.

## Getting started

- [Home](https://NiklasHoelter.github.io/gpuma/index.md)
- [Installation](https://NiklasHoelter.github.io/gpuma/install/index.md)
- [Using with AI agents](https://NiklasHoelter.github.io/gpuma/agents/index.md)

## Usage

- [Command Line Interface](https://NiklasHoelter.github.io/gpuma/cli/index.md)
- [Configuration](https://NiklasHoelter.github.io/gpuma/config/index.md)
